content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has provided information regarding the costs of various glucagon formulations, which include injectable powder, nasal powder, and prefilled pens or syringes. These formulations have differing average wholesale prices (AWP) and National Average Drug Acquisition Costs (NADAC). As of August 2023, the median monthly cost for these glucagon products can range from approximately $249 to $371, depending on the specific formulation and dosage.
